narrative:
Operating expenses are planned at EUR 196M, up just 1.0% on FY2025 despite a 3.0% collective-agreement pay rise. Personnel is half of opex (~830 FTE), IT and licences 22%, premises and branches 10%.

Holding cost growth this low needs efficiency savings of about EUR 4.4M to offset wage inflation and the run cost of the change portfolio. The Cost Efficiency Agent found three levers in the cost data: retail branch consolidation in Inland & North, card-processing vendor consolidation, and automating fund NAV and reporting that still runs on spreadsheets and the legacy Oracle pricing tool.

At the planned cost base C/I is 58.3% — 1.7pp of headroom against the Board's 60% target.

signals.title: Finnish Financial Sector Collective Agreement 2025-27
signals.excerpt: General pay increase of 3.0% in 2026 plus local pots — roughly EUR 3M on Aktia's personnel base.

signals.title: Retail Channel Review — Branch Utilisation
signals.excerpt: 78% of retail transactions are digital; 9 branches in Inland & North average fewer than 25 visits per day.

signals.title: Pricing Tool Migration — Oracle to Snowflake Postgres
signals.excerpt: Legacy Oracle pricing tool scheduled for migration to Snowflake Postgres, removing licence cost and manual price-list reconciliation.
